label: Fitness Centers & Gyms
heroHeading: Recovery your members book, on the days they don’t train
seoDescription: Member retention recovery zones for gyms & fitness clubs. Commercial IceVault, sauna and red light systems that drive recurring revenue.

valueProps.title: A reason to come in on rest days
valueProps.body: Members train hard four or five days a week. Sauna, cold and red light give them something to come in for on the other two, and something a budget gym down the road can’t match.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Cabins, cold rooms and panels made for back-to-back sessions on a busy floor. No plumbing for the cold room, no water testing, no wet change area.

valueProps.title: Little staff time per session
valueProps.body: Members book a slot and start the session themselves. Your team gets training at handover and remote monitoring after it, so a fault shows up before a member reports it.

features.title: A recovery floor, not a spare room
features.body: We plan the space around your layout and your peak hours: where the sauna and cold room sit, how people move between them, and how many can go through in an hour.

features.title: Sell it the way that suits your club
features.body: Included in a higher membership tier, sold as an add-on, or booked per session. The app handles booking and protocols either way, and shows you which modality is actually being used.
